notes.title: Cops Kissing Each Other Demo Release
notes.notes:
Why "Beat Em Up" when you can "Kiss Em Up"? 

When I describe this game to people, two responses come up:

1. Huh?
2. Why are you talking to me?

The confusion is now gone. The demo of the game is here. Give it a download and play the first bit of the game.  

If you like it, please give it a Wishlist for a launch day discount.

Thanks for being you!
